points.quote: Your tutors should give you guidance about the level of AI which is allowed in your assessment task.
points.anchor: Can you use AI-generated material in your work?
points.gist: Tutors should give guidance on the level of AI allowed in an assessment task.

points.quote: If your tutor has not provided guidance on the use of AI-generated material for your assessment, please ask them. If in doubt, assume that AI cannot be used in your assessment task.
points.anchor: Can you use AI-generated material in your work?
points.gist: If no guidance is given, ask your tutor; if in doubt, assume AI cannot be used in the assessment.

points.quote: It is important you do not use AI tools to generate an assignment and submit it as if it were your own work.
points.gist: Do not use AI tools to generate an assignment and submit it as your own work.

points.quote: attempting to pass off work created by artificial intelligence as your own. These activities show a clear intention to deceive the marker and are treated as misconduct.
points.gist: Passing off AI-created work as your own shows clear intention to deceive the marker and is treated as misconduct.

points.quote: The Artificial Intelligence Transparency Scale (AITS) has been created at Sheffield Hallam University, and it uses 5 descriptors to communicate the way in which AI should be used and how it has been used.
points.gist: The Hallam-created AITS uses 5 descriptors to communicate how AI should be used and how it has been used.

points.quote: Sometimes tutors may use the Artificial Intelligence Transparency Scale below to help communicate about how AI may be used, although they may use a different approach.
points.anchor: Can you use AI-generated material in your work?
points.gist: Tutors may use the AI Transparency Scale to communicate permitted AI use, or may use a different approach.

points.quote: If you are acknowledging the use of AI in your work, you should provide a statement about how you have used it.
points.anchor: Acknowledging the use of AI in your work
points.gist: If acknowledging AI use, provide a statement about how you used it.

points.quote: If you have used AI in your work, you need to be clear about whether to reference your use of AI as a source, or to acknowledge your use of AI, or both.
points.anchor: Acknowledging the use of AI in your work
points.gist: If you used AI, be clear whether to reference it as a source, acknowledge it, or both.

points.quote: I used AI at AITS 2 (AI for Shaping) of the Artificial Intelligence Transparency Scale (AITS). Specifically, I used ChatGPT to help brainstorm initial ideas and outline the structure of my essay. I did not use AI to write any part of the content or to edit the final version.
points.anchor: Acknowledging the use of AI in your work
points.gist: Example student statement: used ChatGPT at AITS 2 to brainstorm and outline an essay, and not to write content or edit the final version.

points.quote: rather than seek to prohibit your use of them, we will support you in using them effectively, ethically, and transparently.
points.gist: Rather than prohibiting AI tools, the university will support students to use them effectively, ethically and transparently.

points.quote: Your work will be marked according to the assessment criteria for each task, so it is important you read your assessment brief, and follow any AI-related guidance to succeed at the task and avoid academic misconduct.
points.anchor: Can you use AI-generated material in your work?
points.gist: Read your assessment brief and follow its AI guidance to succeed and avoid academic misconduct.
